subject: slider/numeric combo - update slider only when "Enter" is pressed in the numeric input

messages.author: 46b63db5e5ff7d37
messages.subject: slider/numeric combo - update slider only when "Enter" is pressed in the numeric input
parts:
Hi all,

I'm using the slider/numeric combo (see code below, borrowed form Joe Cheng) in my current project and I'm wondering is there any way to make the slider update only after the "Enter" key is pressed in the numeric input?
The problem with the following code is that the slider reacts too quickly to wait for the user to input a 'long' number, say 256,
Thank you for any help!

library(shiny)

ui <- fluidPage(
  sliderInput("slide", NULL, 0, 10000, 1),
  numericInput("num", NULL, 1)
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  observe({
    updateSliderInput(session, "slide", value = input$num)
  })
  
  observe({
    updateNumericInput(session, "num", value = input$slide)
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)


Best,
Weicheng

Sure.
In my app, the numeric input controls the amount of money the user want to invest and the slider controls the percentage of the investment (current investment / total investment).
I want the user to be able to adjust either the slider or the numeric input to adjust the amount of money they want to invest.
The current problem is the user has to input the numeric value very quickly before the slider 'detect' a change of the numeric input.
You can try to input 5000 SLOWLY in the numeric input in the following example to see my problem.
Thank you!

library(shiny)

ui <- fluidPage(
  sliderInput("slider", NULL, 0, 100, 0),
  numericInput("num", NULL, 0)

)

server <- function(input, output, session) {

total = 10000
  observe({
    updateSliderInput(session, "slider", value = input$num/total*100)
  })
  
  observe({
    updateNumericInput(session, "num", value = input$slider*total/100)
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

messages.subject: Re: slider/numeric combo - update slider only when "Enter" is pressed in the numeric input
parts:
I see what you want, now.

It is possible to make a custom numericInput widget that will update under specified conditions, such as:  when the user presses Enter or shifts focus to another part of the page.  With such a custom input, the slider input won't get updated until the user has really finished entering the number.

There is a shiny article about this:  http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/building-inputs.html

I have recently developed cusom inputs similar to the one you want.  If you find the process difficult, report back and I'll post on Github some of the stuff I have done.
